note: What the four Kettle Creek forage spots can turn up, and the potion ingredients they belong to. One find per spot per school day, the same find for every trainer that day. Grave moss is on this list because Spirit Sight is brewed from it, but it only grows on headstones. Those rules stay in ghosts.json (one a stone a day, three a day, carry six, two to brew). The server refuses to start if this carry number and ghosts.json disagree. Carry limits for the other ingredients are chosen to match that pocket of six. Which spot can yield which ingredient is also chosen: the bible names the ingredients and the four spots, not the pairing.
